payload.description: Scanner emits asset:aiosqlite, asset:asyncpg, and asset:pymysql on python-basic/app.py when only psycopg2 is imported. These are false positives; the drivers share 'connect' as a callName and psycopg2.connect triggers them. Tracked by bug KDATAP-0f7953.
payload.title: python-basic: phantom drivers must not fire
